runtime_encoding.raw: lossless uint64 PC plus lossless 58-bit cache-line number
causal_same_input_history: current exact-PC signed line delta in lossless 58-bit two's complement
prior exact-PC signed line delta in lossless 58-bit two's complement
exact distinct-PC reuse distance in lossless uint64

architecture.state: one single-layer LSTM dynamically routed by exact observed PC
architecture.staleness: standard learned LSTM forget gates see exact distinct-PC reuse distance
architecture.stateful_training: exact-PC keyed chronological TBPTT with state carried and detached at chunk boundaries
architecture.inference_history: fresh exact-PC state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; only the requested suffix is decoded

rank_conditioning: fixed generic 8-value sinusoidal positional code with shared heads

request_count.positive_count_training: smooth-L1 on log positive teacher count

target_decoder.coordinate: every target is relative to the current demand line, never a previous action
target_decoder.delta_vocabulary_order: descending TRAIN frequency with signed-integer tie break
target_decoder.class_bias_initialization: log add-one-smoothed TRAIN exact-class plus OTHER frequency
target_decoder.delta_output_alphabet: up to 255 exact deltas plus one OTHER class
target_decoder.training: unweighted exact-class cross-entropy plus auxiliary smooth-L1 signed-log regression at every teacher rank
target_decoder.decoding: deterministic categorical MAP; exact table value or rounded inverse signed-log OTHER

decode_resource_watchdog.behavior: fail closed and raise before replay; never truncate or change a learned count

captured_stride_actions_role: offline-normal replay, supervised losses, and TRAIN-only learned output vocabulary
gradient_accumulation: weighted by the exact number of natural gate, positive-count, rank-class, and OTHER-regression atoms

persistent_state_accounting: 2H float32 values per exact observed PC; reported separately from weights
